name: RANHILL
recent: Ranhill Utilities 于2026年11月17日公布最新季度业绩，营收6.515亿令吉，净利约3000万令吉，同比大致持平。公司将于2026年12月2日召开第十二届常年股东大会，议程包括续聘核数师、更新股票回购授权及关联交易股东授权。此外，Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments 在10月至11月间多次申报大股东权益变动。
notable: 公布最新季度业绩，营收6.515亿令吉，净利约3000万令吉。
将于2026年12月2日召开第十二届常年股东大会。
risks: Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments 在10月至11月间多次申报大股东权益变动。
earnings: 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收6.570亿令吉，环比增长7.3%，同比增长30.1%；净利7008万令吉，环比增长20.0%，同比增长294.3%；净利率10.7%，高于上一期的9.5%。

recent_en: Ranhill Utilities announced its latest quarterly results on 17 Nov 2026, with revenue of RM651.5 million and net profit of about RM30 million, broadly flat year-on-year. In addition, Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November.
notable_en: Announced latest quarterly results with revenue of RM651.5 million and net profit of about RM30 million.
risks_en: Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM657.0 million, up 7.3% QoQ and 30.1% YoY; net income was RM70.1 million, up 20.0% QoQ and 294.3% YoY; net margin was 10.7%, higher than 9.5% in the previous period.
